stem:
This figure will be turned to a different position.

[Image: A 3D figure made of cubes]

Which of these could be the figure after it is turned?
figure_description: The initial figure is a solid composed of 5 cubes: 4 cubes form an upright T-shape (a horizontal row of 3 cubes at the bottom, and 1 cube centered on top of the middle cube), and a 5th cube is attached to the back face of the leftmost cube of the bottom row. Option A shows an upside-down T-shape (a horizontal row of 3 cubes at the top with 1 cube centered below the middle cube) with a 5th cube attached to the back face of the rightmost cube. Option B shows an upright T-shape with a 5th cube attached to the back face of the rightmost cube. Option C shows an upright T-shape with a 5th cube attached to the front face of the middle bottom cube. Option D shows a vertical column of 3 cubes with 2 cubes extending to the right and backward from the middle cube.
